tracks.title: Ethical Hacking and Offensive Security Foundations
tracks.entry: Use a terminal, explain an IP address and HTTP request, and create a disposable local target.
tracks.limits: An entry pathway into web, network and directory testing; not certification equivalence or permission to test third parties.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: Red Teaming and Adversary Emulation
tracks.entry: Demonstrate scoped enumeration, identity/permission reasoning and the ability to inspect defender telemetry.
tracks.limits: Assumed-breach, controlled emulation with harmless markers. Windows enterprise exercises need an isolated VM lab; no covert implants, live credential theft or production phishing are provisioned.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: SOC Analyst: Triage, Investigation and Response
tracks.entry: Read timestamps, IP addresses and basic authentication/web logs; distinguish an event from an alert.
tracks.limits: Use supplied or self-generated telemetry on the Pi; vendor-specific Sentinel/Defender tasks require that service or an appropriate training tenant.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: Active Directory and Windows Identity Security
tracks.entry: Demonstrate Windows users/groups, basic DNS and TCP/IP, and permission inspection.
tracks.limits: Real Windows domain, GPO and AD CS exercises require isolated licensed/evaluation Windows VMs or a hosted lab. GOAD orchestrates Windows VMs; its Docker launcher does not make domain controllers Pi containers.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: Cloud Security: Identity, Exposure and Detection
tracks.entry: Explain HTTP, role-based access and basic JSON; distinguish cloud control-plane actions from workload traffic.
tracks.limits: Local policy fixtures teach reasoning; actual AWS/Azure/GCP enforcement requires a scoped training account. CloudGoat creates real billable resources and is not provisioned automatically.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: Container and Kubernetes Security
tracks.entry: Run a local container, identify its image and mounts, and explain processes and file permissions.
tracks.limits: Docker exercises work on the supported Pi profiles. Kubernetes enforcement needs a real disposable cluster and a CNI that implements NetworkPolicy; YAML validation alone is not runtime evidence.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: Secure Development and DevSecOps
tracks.entry: Write a small program, use Git and run its tests.
tracks.limits: Exercises use owned toy services and local pipelines; a passing scanner is not a security certification.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: Digital Forensics and Incident Response
tracks.entry: Handle files, compute hashes and interpret timestamps without modifying the original evidence.
tracks.limits: Use licensed public datasets and synthetic artifacts. Large disk/memory images may exceed Pi storage; Windows memory interpretation needs symbols/tools matching the supplied image.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: Threat Hunting and Threat Intelligence
tracks.entry: Query small log datasets and distinguish source facts from analyst judgments.
tracks.limits: Use public reports and synthetic telemetry; this track does not authorize investigating private individuals or scanning report indicators.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: Malware Analysis with Safe Training Artifacts
tracks.entry: Read simple code and binary metadata, understand hashes and distinguish static from dynamic analysis.
tracks.limits: Start with benign toy programs and published traces. Live malware must not run in these Docker labs; it requires an appropriately isolated VM environment and reviewed sample handling. REMnux now offers ARM64 appliances, but individual tools and Pi deployment remain separate compatibility questions.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: Mobile Application Security
tracks.entry: Understand HTTP and application permissions; use an owned test device or appropriate emulator.
tracks.limits: MASTG practice apps and an Android/iOS test environment are required for operational assessments. A Pi Docker container is not an Android/iOS emulator; fixtures are preparation, not a substitute for device evidence.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: API Security and Authorization Engineering
tracks.entry: Read HTTP and JSON, use two synthetic accounts and explain authentication versus authorization.
tracks.limits: Use designated lessons and owned API fixtures. GraphQL introspection or a visible route alone is not a vulnerability.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: Applied Cryptography and Protocol Security
tracks.entry: Work with bytes, hexadecimal and small Python programs; distinguish encoding from encryption.
tracks.limits: Use established libraries and training data. Toy arithmetic explains mechanisms; it is not production cryptographic implementation guidance.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: Wireless and IoT Security
tracks.entry: Understand local networking, device ownership and basic authentication.
tracks.limits: MQTT exercises run in Docker. Radio capture/injection requires suitable owned hardware and legal scope; firmware emulation is device/architecture-specific.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: OT and Industrial Control Security
tracks.entry: Read network diagrams and distinguish operational safety from information confidentiality.
tracks.limits: Use software simulators and supplied captures only. No real PLC, safety system or industrial network is targeted; a simulator cannot establish physical safety.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: Security Architecture, Risk and Governance
tracks.entry: Understand service users, data and business purpose; distinguish a requirement from evidence.
tracks.limits: Uses public NIST guidance and fictional organizations. Completion is not an audit attestation or legal/compliance advice.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: Vulnerability Management and Exposure Prioritization
tracks.entry: Understand service versions, asset ownership and the difference between an advisory and confirmed exposure.
tracks.limits: Use synthetic inventories and approved scan exports. EPSS estimates and KEV membership inform decisions but do not prove exploitation on your system.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: Vulnerability Research and Bug Bounty Practice
tracks.entry: Reproduce a lab web/API finding, read simple code and understand scope restrictions.
tracks.limits: Practice on owned/open training software. Program rules and explicit authorization govern any later real target; no bounty or career result is promised.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.

tracks.title: AI and LLM Application Security
tracks.entry: Understand HTTP, JSON, application authorization and the difference between model output and trusted program state.
tracks.limits: Use deterministic mock models and synthetic data first. These tests validate application boundaries, not the general resistance of a real language model; real-model testing needs a separately configured model and budget.
tracks.verification: 18 server-graded concept/micro-exercise checks; 16 hands-on artifact checks requiring evidence review.
